sentences.question: The buyer asks, "What exactly are we buying?" Write your answer.
sentences.model: Complete Executive Care combines an annual Executive Health Assessment or designated Whole-Body MRI, expedited diagnostics and expert review, eligible planned global treatment, Executive Travel and year-round wellness support.

sentences.question: The client chooses RegeneraLife and wants the Full Executive Health Assessment, Enhanced Full Cardiac and Neurodegenerative Disease Screening. Which option matches?
options: Option A with a $4,000 additional deductible (correct)
Option B with a $6,000 additional deductible
Option C is mandatory for every RegeneraLife client

sentences.question: The proposed member says, "My prior condition is covered immediately because there was no questionnaire, correct?"
options: Correct. No questionnaire means immediate coverage (false)

No. The Global Medical pre-existing provision excludes it for the first 36 months. Limited coverage may apply later under the current policy, and I cannot decide whether your condition qualifies (correct)
The same limitation applies to every wellness service (false)

sentences.model: Executive Flex matches that approach: the company pays 100% of Single and each executive may upgrade to Couple or Family and pay the difference through payroll deduction, using a Health Spending Account where applicable.
